note_en: To say "A isn't as ... as B," Chinese uses A 没有 B (那么) + adjective: 法庭的环境也没有大案子审理时那么严肃 "the courtroom wasn't as solemn as during big trials." Don't try to negate 比 with 不 for this meaning; 没有…那么… is the natural negative of a comparison, and 那么 corresponds to the first "as" in English.
